def transform(grid):

    # frontier lines: full rows/cols of one non-zero color

    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    colors={v for r in grid for v in r if v not in (0, grid[frows[0]][0] if frows else None)}
    for c in colors:
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]==c]
        if not cells: continue
        imin=min(i for i,j in cells); imax=max(i for i,j in cells)
        jmin=min(j for i,j in cells); jmax=max(j for i,j in cells)
        ci=(imin+imax)/2; cj=(jmin+jmax)/2
        if ci%1==0 and int(ci) in frows and cj%1==0 and int(cj) in fcols:
            ci,cj=int(ci),int(cj)
            new=set(cells)
            for i,j in cells:

            for i,j in new:
